name: Lilith
source:
One of the girls living within the castle at the flower garden, a troublesome narcissistic girl with a sometimes tsundere-like personality. No one is able to handle her anger when enraged. 

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/08/10/vanilla/]Official Site[/url]]
